items.headline: BWXT's BANR microreactor chosen for Canadian transportable plant
items.what_happened: BWXT Technologies announced that Prodigy Clean Energy, Pabineau First Nation, and Eel River Bar First Nation have selected its BANR microreactor for a Transportable Nuclear Power Plant (TNPP) project in Belledune, New Brunswick. The TNPP will feature up to 50 megawatts electric, with the pilot project intended to validate plant logistics and operational requirements for mass deployment across Canada's North.
items.why_it_matters: A 50 MWe deployment in Canada's remote regions signals growing buyer confidence in transportable microreactor systems for northern markets. The Indigenous-led project targets late-2030s operation and could establish a commercial template for Arctic power supplies.

items.headline: Last Energy's Texas pilot clears DOE safety analysis approval
items.what_happened: The U.S. Department of Energy approved Last Energy's Documented Safety Analysis (DSA) for its 20 MWe PWR-5 pilot reactor at Texas A&M-RELLIS. The DSA is the final and most comprehensive safety analysis in the DOE's licensing process. Last Energy now moves into the readiness review, the final step before authorization for criticality and reactor operations.
items.why_it_matters: DSA approval is the penultimate gate before a pilot reactor becomes operational. For a 20 MWe design based on existing PWR technology, reaching this stage on schedule accelerates the path to commercial deployment and validates the DOE Reactor Pilot Program's fast-track approach.
items.binding_note: DSA approval is a formal DOE authorization, not binding until criticality is approved

items.headline: Centrus and Radiant sign definitive HALEU supply contract
items.what_happened: Centrus Energy and Radiant Nuclear announced a definitive multi-year contract to supply high-assay, low-enriched uranium (HALEU) for Radiant's Kaleidos microreactors. Under the agreement, Centrus will begin delivering HALEU before the end of the decade. The contract includes Radiant prepayments to Centrus to support its domestic commercial enrichment capacity program.
items.why_it_matters: HALEU fuel supply is a critical bottleneck for microreactor deployment. This contract addresses fuel supply in parallel with reactor development and includes a source of U.S.-origin, unobligated HALEU suitable for defense applications, removing a major constraint on microreactor commercialization.

items.headline: Westinghouse eVinci sets temperature record during zero-power criticality tests
items.what_happened: Westinghouse Electric Company completed zero-power high-temperature criticality testing for its eVinci microreactor. The milestone testing saw the reactor reach criticality at 663 degrees Celsius, demonstrating a defining milestone in the program's build-test-learn development journey.
items.why_it_matters: Zero-power criticality tests confirm the nuclear physics design and core thermal-hydraulic performance before full-power operation. A 663°C criticality temperature validates eVinci's high-temperature design envelope and moves the project forward in its DOE Reactor Pilot Program timeline.
